[ASSISTANT_SAID] To reboot a CentOS 7 machine on Google Cloud using SSH, the command is `sudo reboot`.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To shut down the machine and then power it back on, the command is `sudo shutdown -r now`.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To exit the current session, the command is `exit`.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The command `logout` can also be used to log out of a login shell or terminal session.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If using a GUI terminal, the user can click on the "X" button in the top right corner to close the window.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The `systemctl list-unit-files` command shows a list of all unit files and their current state on a CentOS 7 machine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] There is no need to log out after running the `systemctl list-unit-files` command; the user can simply close the terminal window or press the `Enter` key to return to the command prompt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can use the `Ctrl + C` keyboard shortcut to immediately stop the command and return to the command prompt.
